$comment: Host overload cascade. Defaults live in host-overload-settings.mjs; override host.maxWaitMs (900000 milliseconds: mandatory gates wait for host load, then proceed through slot admission; WE_HOST_MAX_WAIT_MS overrides), host.maxLoadPerCore (2.0), host.capacitySignal (load by default; cpu-mem opts into measured CPU idle and memory free; WE_HOST_CAPACITY_SIGNAL), host.capacity.cpuIdleLowPct / memFreeLowPct (15/15) and cpuIdleMediumPct / memFreeMediumPct (30/30; WE_HOST_CAPACITY_CPU_IDLE_LOW_PCT, WE_HOST_CAPACITY_MEM_FREE_LOW_PCT, WE_HOST_CAPACITY_CPU_IDLE_MEDIUM_PCT, WE_HOST_CAPACITY_MEM_FREE_MEDIUM_PCT), host.minMemoryHeadroomMb (2048: free RAM + free swap in MB below which no new background heavy job or review session starts; it waits), host.maxReviewDispatchPerTick (2 new review sessions per review-daemon tick at most), lanes.transcripts.explicitScan (true: permits explicit requests only), or lanes.gc.schedule (86400000 milliseconds between completed serialized passes). Routine whois NEVER scans. lane-pool gc is the scheduled maintenance entrypoint.
